svg.title: Your callouts, all together. — Callout Studio
svg.desc: The production settings list shows Idea, Meeting, and Research with two IDs each above all thirteen expanded built-in callouts, with their actual color swatches and editing controls. Production components in phone layout with synthetic content on a purple promotional background, without a simulated Obsidian workspace. Mobile store artwork, 900 by 1600 pixels.
